**Nukashine** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

Nukashine was created by Lewis of the Eta Psi fraternity at Vault-Tec University in November 2076. [2] The spirit itself is incredibly potent, causes blackouts, severe hangovers, and is potentially lethal, as the fellow Pi Mu fraternity found out during their "eviction party." [3] 

Created with the original intent of providing a source of funds for feeding Lewis's Nuka-Cola collector's addiction, but wound up catapulting the fraternity to university-wide fame, and led Judy Lowell, the chapter president, to set up a speakeasy in the basement of Big Al's Tattoo Parlor, with a lab and distillery set up in the basement's back room.

A Sugar-Free Nukashine also exists, with the lack of sugar allowing the beverage to be consumed without any risk of blackouts.

A high-proof distilled liquor brewed using Nuka-Cola Quantum and Nuclear Material, fresh Nukashine decreases the AP cost of sprinting by 80%, increases AP regeneration by 50%, and increase falling speed by 25% while inflicting 30 Rads and causing the consumer to blackout after the drink's duration. After blacking out, the consumer will find themselves in one of 36 random locations, while Strength, Endurance, and Agility are reduced by one for 20 seconds.

Similar to other fermented beverages, Nukashine is initially crafted as fermentable Nukashine, offering no benefits, inflicting 30 rads upon consumption, and having a significantly high disease chance of 9%. The ingredients list, found on two notes provided by Biv and found in the locked supply closet in the backroom of The Nukashine inside Big Al's Tattoo Parlor, lists the pre-War recipe. [4] 

After being fermented further, Nukashine becomes vintage Nukashine, gaining the effect of increasing unarmed damage by 100% and boosting DR by 25 while also retaining the other positive effects of the fresh version.

There are 36 possible locations for the player to wake up at after blacking out. There will be an empty Nukashine bottle laying nearby.

The Chem and Hoop Shack south of Camp McClintock.

A raft southwest of the Ransacked Bunker.

A tent on a cliff in the mountains east of WV Lumber Co..

A lakeside fishing spot East of Middle Mountain Pitstop.

An open air banquet East of Tyler County Fairgrounds.

A stage appearance West of Hemlock Holes.

A Gourmands camp to the north of the North Mountain Lookout.

A tightrope to the southeast of Mountainside Bed & Breakfast.

A raider tower Northeast of Becker Farm.

A skeleton picnic West of Moth-Home.

The sludge trailer behind the Red Rocket Filling Station.

The Sickleman cabin South of North Kanawha Lookout.

Near Autumn Acre Cabin, next to the Teddy Fear murder scene.

A physics test at the peak of Johnson's Acre.

A treehouse North of Dolly Sods Lookout.

A monorail car near the cranberry glade.

A meeting table in the bog, featuring a Teddy Fear and several skeletons, north of Superior Sunset Farm.

A clifftop boobytrap camp Northeast of Devil's Backbone.

An explosive Scarecrow Northwest of National Radio Astronomy Research Center.

A dead treasure hunter South of Dagger's Den.

A fishing boat south of Black Mountain Ordnance Works.

A makeshift Volleyball court South of Vault 51.

Nukashine can be crafted using the brewing and distilling functionality introduced in *Wild Appalachia*.
